escalations.title: CRITICAL JavaScript Injection in Handlebars via ts-jest
escalations.description: handlebars@4.7.8 pulled transitively by ts-jest@^29.1.2 (Backend dev dependency). CVSS 9.8 — arbitrary code execution via malformed template inputs / AST type confusion. CVE IDs: GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q, GHSA-3mfm-83xf-c92r, GHSA-xhpv-hc6g-r9c6, GHSA-9cx6-37pm-9jff, GHSA-xjpj-3mr7-gcpf.

escalations.title: CRITICAL Vitest Build Toolchain Path Traversal (esbuild + vite)
escalations.description: vitest@2.0.5 (Frontend dev dependency) pulls esbuild (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99) and vite (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9) with path traversal CVEs. Source code exposure risk during dev server operation. Affects any developer running `npm run dev` or `npm test`.

bugs.title: Shared types missing blocked_by field (FR-dependency-api-types)
bugs.description: UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput in portal/Shared/api.ts lack blocked_by?: string[] required by FR-dependency-api-types. DependencyPicker.tsx works around this with `as any` casts at lines 291 and 293.
bugs.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both interfaces in portal/Shared/api.ts. Remove the as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx.

bugs.title: Direct DB calls from teamDispatches.ts route handler
bugs.description: Route handler calls getDb() and runs SQL queries inline — no service layer. Violates 'No direct DB calls from route handlers'. File also has no // Verifies: traceability and no test file.
bugs.recommendation: Extract to portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts. Add spec, traceability, and tests.

bugs.title: Duplicate UpdateBugInput / UpdateFeatureRequestInput diverge from Shared layer
bugs.description: Both types are defined in portal/Shared/api.ts (without blocked_by) AND redefined in featureRequestService.ts and bugService.ts (with blocked_by). Violates 'Shared types are single source of truth'. Root cause of QO-001.
bugs.recommendation: Add blocked_by to Shared types (fixes QO-001), then remove service-layer duplicate definitions.

bugs.title: Silent error swallowing in BugDetail, FeatureRequestDetail, RepoSelector
bugs.description: Three .catch(() => {}) calls silently discard errors. Failed repo-list fetches leave users with empty selectors and no feedback. Violates 'Never swallow errors silently'.
bugs.recommendation: Log and set error state for user-visible feedback. If genuinely optional, add inline suppression comment.

bugs.title: TeamsPage and team-dispatches route are untraced with no spec backing
bugs.description: portal/Frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx and portal/Backend/src/routes/teamDispatches.ts implement a feature with no Functional Requirements in Specifications/, no // Verifies: comment, and no test coverage. Untraced scope creep.
bugs.recommendation: Write a spec with FR IDs for team-dispatches. Add traceability comments and tests.

bugs.title: FR-070..095 missing from authoritative spec + FR ID collision
bugs.description: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md ends at FR-069. FR-070..095 implemented in portal/ are only in Plans/. Worse: Plans/orchestrator-cycle-dashboard and Plans/image-upload both define FR-070..076 for different features — ID collision.
bugs.recommendation: Append FR-070..095 to canonical spec. Renumber colliding IDs with distinct prefixes (FR-IMG-*, FR-ORC-*).

bugs.title: QS / Prototype Pollution Injection in Express (production)
bugs.description: express@4.18.2 → body-parser → qs (vulnerable). Prototype pollution via query string or POST body. CVE: qs proto/constructor pollution. Is production dependency.

bugs.title: Pino severely outdated — 2 major versions behind (8.17.0 vs 10.x)
bugs.description: pino@8.17.0 in Backend. Latest: 10.3.1. Two major versions behind — missing security patches, performance fixes, and bug fixes from pino 9.x and 10.x.
bugs.recommendation: npm install pino@10 (review release notes for breaking changes)

bugs.title: React Router Open Redirect via protocol-relative URL (production)
bugs.description: react-router-dom@6.26.0 vulnerable to open redirect via protocol-relative URLs (//evil.com). CVE: GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42. Production frontend exposure.
